original_test_intent: Inject a Data Fabric CCM watchdog fault on each required socket, verify the prescribed SyncFlood warm reset and a fresh CCM-specific BERT/CPER record, then prove coherent-fabric, memory and inter-socket health after boot with reset state restored.
original_method: Map sockets and CCM instances; validate errortype1; define threshold role; capture raw S5 reset status and BERT baseline without losing evidence; inject one socket once under OOB console; timestamp SyncFlood/reset/boot; decode new CCM-specific MCA/CPER source; validate memory, xGMI/coherent traffic and OS health; restore threshold, reset status and BIOS/HDT configuration.
manual_activity: The FAE maps CCM per socket, approves watchdog/threshold/reset policy, manages HDT reset-status evidence, runs one injection under OOB console and restores coherent-fabric and platform state.

Vendor proof --dferror errortype1 selects CCM WDT and expected SyncFlood/reset response
MCA threshold FF5/FFE encoding, CCM relevance and raw before/target/restore values
S5_RESET_STATUS[SyncFlood] definition, persistence, approved clear/readback and freshness method
